asr.full_text: Welcome to this Windows channel and this is the Tech News Update. We are Monday, May 15th, 2017 and today in our Tech News Update we have Netflix that has changed its app in the Android Google Play Store. And that means that if you have a rooted device, Netflix app, when you try to download it, will say it's incompatible with your device now it's sad because a lot of people have rooted devices not for piracy or anything simply because something they need to do requires the device to be rooted and of course piracy is the problem why Netflix doesn't want you to have Netflix on a rooted device. So I don't know if they're going to change their mind on this. Of course, there are ways to install the Netflix app differently, that we'll still have it, but I'm not sure that's a very good decision. Well, a major operation is going on in the United States in many countries around the world for DE crackdown of tech support scammers it seems that many many police forces around the world have coordinated their efforts try to crack down and you know the story as much as the cantive tech support cappers you know are very, very popular in the past few years. I had many clients actually fall to this and call phone numbers where it said you gotta call here, and make sure that your computer has a big problem and you need to call tech support and so on. So, it's a good thing. Let's hope that these scammers will be less and less present on the web in the next few months and years. Well, everybody has probably noticed that every news bulletin seemed to talk about the major malware WannaCry that actually has been going around the world and I'll have separate video explaining this because in the news there's a lot a false information there's a lot of things that are not mentioned and I want to really put it very clearly as to what this is, how it's spreading, and if you are not in danger with this. I've seen a lot of people on Facebook saying hey be careful you can be infected by this. No no no, wait let's you know have it perfectly explained in a separate video. but every country around the world is pretty much affected, even China has apparently hundreds of thousands of computers affected. So, for many companies, that for a very simple reason many companies did not patch a flaw that Microsoft have sent a update in the month of March. Windows XP has been patched! Yes, because of this you know really amazing moment, Windows XP computers were of course some of computers infected by that malware. So in a very surprise and exceptional move, Microsoft has issued an update to fix the flaw in Windows XP It seems that it was important enough and there were still... ... so many XP computers around, around, working around that, basically, with Windows XP that they had to do something about it So unfortunately, there are still too many Windows XP computers out there. Well, NSA hacktools, Microsoft, says, are partly to blame. And actually Microsoft does say that stockpiling of hacking tools by governments are partly to blame for the WannaCry and different types of malware that we could have and that the governments need to stop to do that because it is putting everybody at danger of some of course malware attacks and viruses. So, basically partly to blame of, NSA Act tools. Department of Defense in the United States says that they are pushing to go even faster with their Windows 10 migration and that they want to end the Windows 10 migration on their systems by the end of this year. So that means that they are going to push to make sure that Windows 10 is pretty much everywhere within the Department of Defense computers and finally Intel has announced that there will be a new Core i9 CPU for iNPCs after having Core i3, i5s and i7 i7 usually being the the higher end one, a core i9 will now exist with much... much more power than the i7 so it's going to be interesting to see when this comes out and it will probably be you know for mostly very very high end machines that require a lot of power in computing. So this was the TechNews Update for Monday, May 15th, 2017. If you enjoyed our videos, please subscribe, give us thumbs up, if you like our live shows and everything, why not give us a little Paypal donation, help us to continue, Patreon.com slash radion-computers is where you can also, you know, give us and support us with a little PayPal donation, helps us continue and patreon.com slash radioandcomputers is where you can also you know, give us and support us with a little something Thank you so much for watching
